newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola EPS view cut.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said analyst Jack Geraghty lowered his Motorola Inc earnings estimate, cutting the third quarter forecast to $0.43 per share from $0.48, the 1996 estimate to $2.20 per share from $2.30 and the 1997 view to $2.84 per share from $3.02.

-- The firm said the changes were made before Motorola's announcement Wednesday that it expects third quarter earnings to be below the $0.54 per share earned in the prior quarter and below Wall Street's consensus estimate of $0.50 per share.
-- Geraghty was not immediately available to comment.
-- Motorola stock was off 1-1/2 to 49-1/8 in early trade.
